name: native-select
description: Native guidance for the minimal menu treatment of a bound SwiftUI Picker.
docs: Apply `.pickerStyle(.menu)` directly to a native `Picker`. The registry adds no wrapper because the one-line native style is the entire treatment.
accessibility: Retains native Picker accessibility, menu, and selection behavior.
Requires caller-supplied labels and option text.
Keeps selection state external through the Picker binding.
Inherits Dynamic Type, enabled state, tint, and layout direction.
